env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env CGO_ENABLED=0
env GOEXPERIMENT=

cd recon

logos run .
stdout '^v1: \{"title":"hi"\}$'
stdout '^check: sentinel$'
stdout '^std: \{"k":"v"\}$'
stdout '^template-ok$'
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt

logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
exists out/data.go
exists out/data_jsonv2.go
# the companion carries the jsontext import, the main file does not
exec grep -E 'import _logos_jsontext' out/data_jsonv2.go
! exec grep -E '_logos_jsontext' out/data.go
# the main file keeps the imports its retained declarations use ...
exec grep -E '"errors"' out/data.go
exec grep -E '"encoding/json"$' out/main.go
# ... and the companion does not steal encoding/json for _logos_json uses
! exec grep -E '"encoding/json"$' out/data_jsonv2.go
# the raw template line survives the split byte-identical
exec grep -F 'import "encoding/json/jsontext"' out/data.go

cd out
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
go vet ./...
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ..

-- recon/go.mod --
module example.com/recon

go 1.27

-- recon/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
)

func main() {
	v := Data{Title: "hi"}
	buf, err := v.MarshalJSON()
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Println("marshal err:", err)
		return
	}
	fmt.Println("v1:", string(buf))
	if err := check(""); err != nil {
		fmt.Println("check:", err)
	}
	fmt.Println(template)
	m := map[string]string{"k": "v"}
	jb, merr := json.Marshal(m)
	if merr != nil {
		fmt.Println("std marshal err:", merr)
		return
	}
	fmt.Println("std:", string(jb))
	fmt.Println("template-ok")
}

-- recon/data.lgo --
//go:build goexperiment.jsonv2

package main

import "errors"

type Data struct {
	Title string `json:"title"`
}

var errSentinel = errors.New("sentinel")

func check(s string) error {
	if s == "" {
		return errSentinel
	}
	return nil
}

func (v Data) Validate() error { return check(v.Title) }; func helper() string { return "h" }

const template = `line one
import "encoding/json/jsontext"
line three`
